subject.title: [Feature]: Batch WhatsApp messages by messageTimestamp instead of receive time

question: Should WhatsApp server-timestamp coalescing be added as an opt-in setting, enabled by default, or declined?
rationale: This request introduces a new user-visible grouping, latency, and configuration contract; source inspection cannot determine the desired tolerance, maximum hold, or upgrade behavior without maintainer intent.

options.title: Opt-in bounded coalescing
options.body: Add a disabled-by-default WhatsApp setting with explicit timestamp tolerance, maximum receive-time hold, and existing flush boundaries.

options.title: Default bounded coalescing
options.body: Enable timestamp-aware grouping for all WhatsApp users and require fresh-install plus upgrade proof for the changed timing semantics.

options.title: Retain receive-time debounce
options.body: Keep the current behavior and document longer debounce windows as the supported latency-versus-context workaround.

recommendation.title: Opt-in bounded coalescing
recommendation.body: Add a disabled-by-default WhatsApp setting with explicit timestamp tolerance, maximum receive-time hold, and existing flush boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing product review and strongest recent provenance on shared debounce and the active WhatsApp path make this the best available decision owner.
